CHANGELOG updated in GoblinFoxDragon: CRITICAL fix: level/XP/Flow, mining/fishing skill, and equipment now all persist continuously (1Hz tick sync + a real equipment write path) instead of relying on a disconnect-time save that a systemctl restart always skipped. Live-verified: real level-up + gear survive independently of any disconnect. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)
